briefdescription.para: Ordered documents of the standard output of one command, one for each piece of output.
Result of a command: exit code, the documents of the standard output, and the failures.

detaileddescription.para: The documents are written as they are, and the failures are written as diagnostic lines on standard error. No copy is made between the creation of the output and its write.

briefdescription.para: Exit code when a command succeeds or finds matches.
Exit code when find matches nothing or expect disagrees with actual edits.
Exit code when argument parsing, validation, I/O, or a transaction fails.
Line feed that ends each line of a diagnostic and each summary line.

memberdef.argsstring: (int exitCode, Documents documents={}, jam::Array< juce::Result > failures={})
memberdef.name: getOutput

briefdescription.para: Builds an Output from the documents and the failures of a command.

detaileddescription.para: Both are moved into the Output.

parameterdescription.para: The exit code of the command.
The documents of the standard output, in write order. It is empty when no output is written.
The failures, each written as a diagnostic line on standard error. It is empty when there is none.

simplesect.para: The exit code, the documents, and the failures.

briefdescription.para: Wraps text in one document, or returns no document when the text is empty.

parameterdescription.para: The text, moved into the document.
The path of the document, or empty for standard output.

simplesect.para: One document holding the text, or no document.

briefdescription.para: Appends documents to a list, moving each of them, so that no document is copied.

parameterdescription.para: The list that receives the documents.
The documents to append. They are moved out.

briefdescription.para: Builds the output of a command that failed with one status.

parameterdescription.para: The failed status.

simplesect.para: Exit code exitError, no documents, and the status as the only failure.

briefdescription.para: Checks whether standard output is connected to an interactive terminal.

simplesect.para: True when stdout is a TTY.

briefdescription.para: Checks whether the input of a command is an interactive terminal.

detaileddescription.para: Supplied input is never a terminal. Only the process standard input can be one.

parameterdescription.para: The supplied input, or nullopt when the process standard input is read.

simplesect.para: True when no input is supplied and standard input is a TTY.

briefdescription.para: Formats a diagnostic line with the program name as its prefix.

parameterdescription.para: The types of the pieces.
The pieces of the message, without a newline.

simplesect.para: The program name, the diagnostic separator, the message, and one newline.

briefdescription.para: Builds a failed result whose message holds the pieces, in order.

detaileddescription.para: The message has no program name and no newline. See getDiagnostic for the diagnostic line.

parameterdescription.para: The types of the pieces.
The pieces of the message.

simplesect.para: A failed juce::Result with the message.

briefdescription.para: Builds the output of a failed command.

parameterdescription.para: The types of the pieces of the diagnostic message.
The pieces of the diagnostic message.

simplesect.para: Exit code exitError, empty standard output, and the diagnostic on standard error.

briefdescription.para: Returns the first failed status in the order given.

detaileddescription.para: The order of the statuses decides which failure is returned, so the same inputs give the same failure.

parameterdescription.para: The statuses, one for each job, in job order.

simplesect.para: The first failed status, or ok when every status succeeded.

briefdescription.para: Writes both streams of an Output and returns the exit code.

detaileddescription.para: A failed write of the standard output gives exitError, and the failure is reported on standard error. A closed pipe is not a failure.

parameterdescription.para: The command result to write.

simplesect.para: The exit code of the command, or exitError when the standard output write fails.

briefdescription.para: Passes the pieces of the diagnostic line of a failure to a function, in order, without building the line.

detaileddescription.para: The pieces are the program name, the diagnostic separator, the message, and the line feed. The function writes each piece where it goes, so the line text is never built.

parameterdescription.para: The type of the callable. It takes a std::string_view.
The failure whose message is the diagnostic.
Receives each piece in order.

briefdescription.para: Appends one piece to a summary line of the standard output, as UTF-8 bytes.

parameterdescription.para: The line that receives the piece.
The piece to append.

briefdescription.para: Appends one integer piece to a summary line, as decimal digits.

parameterdescription.para: The line that receives the piece.
The integer to append.

briefdescription.para: Appends one character piece to a summary line, as UTF-8 bytes.

parameterdescription.para: The line that receives the piece.
The character to append.

briefdescription.para: Appends the message of a result to a summary line, as UTF-8 bytes.

parameterdescription.para: The line that receives the message.
The result whose error message is appended.

briefdescription.para: Appends one piece to the message of a juce::Result.

parameterdescription.para: The message that receives the piece.
The piece to append. An empty piece appends nothing.

briefdescription.para: Appends one integer piece to the message of a juce::Result, as decimal digits.

parameterdescription.para: The message that receives the piece.
The integer to append.

briefdescription.para: Appends one character piece to the message of a juce::Result.

parameterdescription.para: The message that receives the piece.
The character to append.

briefdescription.para: Appends the message of a result to the message of another result.

parameterdescription.para: The message that receives the piece.
The result whose error message is appended.

briefdescription.para: Process exit codes, and the output of a command as documents and failures.

detaileddescription.para: A verb returns an Output, so that no verb writes to a process stream. write sends the Output to the process streams, once, at the end of the command.
